label: BigFields
description: Karoo data fields in digits as large as the screen allows, for riders who would rather not have to wear reading glasses on the bike. Four Big Page fields fill a whole data page with one or two values in rows of equal height; 32 single fields read native Karoo values. Numbers are fitted to the real outline of the digits in a condensed font: on a Karoo 3, 180 px digits on a two-value page against 130 px for native fields. Six styles with zone colours for heart rate and power.
